name: staff-brand-membership-sync
title: Synchronize new staff with BrandMembership
description: Ensure the existing createStaff flow creates an active BrandMembership staff scope for the selected restaurant Brand without changing the frontend contract.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Frontend already sends restaurantForStaff through CreateStaff. The fix belongs at the Staff creation boundary so every new staff record receives the required BrandMembership scope.
